## Legend

`I-NNN` — idea id, stable forever · 💡 open · 🅿 parked (with a date and reason) · `[x]` promoted (link to the spec, ADR or impact verdict) or closed ❌ (reason) · 🏷 area as in the roadmap legend.
The roadmap may reference an idea while it is open: `- [ ] [I-NNN](backlog.md#i-nnn) · Title 🅿`.
